claims.text: Il San Pietro di Positano is set into the cliffside on the Amalfi Coast.

findings.quote: Nestled into the cliffside, this exclusive sanctuary embodies the essence of timeless Italian hospitality.
the unfiltered beauty of the Amalfi Coast

claims.text: Rooms feature hand-painted ceramic tiles, custom-made furniture and fine Italian textiles.

findings.quote: hand-painted ceramic tiles, custom-made furniture, and fine Italian textiles evoke the region’s rich heritage

claims.text: Classic rooms have a private terrace overlooking the sea.

findings.quote: Uniquely designed and furnished rooms providing all the modern comforts and amenities, with a private terrace overlooking the sea.

claims.text: The Prestige rooms with a Positano view have large furnished terraces overlooking the town of Positano and the islands of Li Galli and Capri.

findings.quote: Prestige rooms – Positano view
Large furnished terraces overlook the town of Positano and the islands of Li galli and Capri.

claims.text: The Virginia suite occupies an entire floor, with a privileged entrance to the swimming pool and direct lift access.

findings.quote: The Virginia suite
Suite 59 occupies an entire floor, with a privileged entrance to the swimming pool and direct lift access.

claims.text: The Signature rooms were designed by Fausta Gaetani.

findings.quote: The Signature rooms, designed by Fausta Gaetani

claims.text: Guests can charter the hotel's private yachts, The Dreamer and The Joey II, to explore the Amalfi Coast, Capri, Ischia and the Gulf of Naples.

findings.quote: Explore the captivating beauty of the Amalfi Coast, Capri, Ischia and the Gulf of Naples aboard Il San Pietro’s private yachts.
Perfect for more intimate excursions, _The Dreamer_ and _The Joey II_ provide unrivaled comfort
To charter one of our boats, please speak directly with the concierge.

claims.text: The hotel's organic gardens span ten cascading terraces and supply vegetables, herbs and citrus.

findings.quote: Spanning ten cascading terraces, our organic gardens supply the hotel with fresh vegetables, herbs, and citrus

claims.text: Zass restaurant has panoramic sea views.

findings.quote: Zass, our Michelin-starred restaurant with panoramic sea views

claims.text: Conde Nast Traveler reports that founder Carlino Cinque opened the hotel in 1970 and it has never left the family since.

findings.quote: Founder Carlino Cinque opened the hotel in 1970 with just 33 rooms, and it has never left the family since.

claims.text: Conde Nast Traveler mentions La Prairie treatments at the spa.

findings.quote: The La Prairie treatments at the spa gave me a reason to retreat out of the sun

claims.text: Conde Nast Traveler lists a small gym with sea views and yoga and Pilates classes.

findings.quote: Spa, a small gym with sea views, yoga and Pilates classes, and a tennis court

claims.text: An elevator cut into the cliff runs from the lobby straight to the beach club.

findings.quote: Take an elevator cut into the cliff straight from the lobby to this hidden gem

claims.text: The beach club is a private beach in a natural cove with clear Mediterranean waters.

findings.quote: Welcome to the only private beach in Positano, an exclusive natural cove with crystal-clear Mediterranean waters.

claims.text: The regulation-size tennis court sits between the rock face and a pebble beach by the sea.

findings.quote: nestled between the rugged rock face and pristine pebble beach, our regulation-size court, with its dramatic backdrop is the perfect setting for a friendly match by the sea

claims.text: The rooms are carved into the cliff overlooking the Mediterranean Sea.

findings.quote: Carved into the cliff overlooking the Mediterranean Sea, our rooms are a combination of understated luxury

claims.text: The swimming pool is set on a terrace overlooking the sea and the coastal village of Praiano.

findings.quote: set on a terrace overlooking the sea and the charming coastal village of Praiano

claims.text: Conde Nast Traveler places the hotel about a mile down the coast from the center of Positano.

findings.quote: About a mile down the coast from the center of Positano

claims.text: Conde Nast Traveler reports the hotel has an age limit for children, with ages 10 and up allowed.

findings.quote: this hotel has an age limit for children (ages 10 and up are allowed)

claims.text: WhataHotel notes premium pricing reflecting the ultra-luxury positioning.
